description: Built 31-10-2026 from VATSIM ZLA's 'Los Angeles Tower SOP' v5.95 (19-03-2026), section 1-3. Only Over-Ocean Traffic has an explicit scheduled time band ('noise abatement configuration between 0000L and 0630L') -- modelled as a hard local-time band. West/East Traffic are NOT time-gated: the choice is wind-driven ('use East when West's tailwind exceeds 10kt'), left to the engine's own per-slot tailwind check (tailwindDryKt=10kt) rather than a second band. West keeps penalty 0 as the stated default; East gets penalty 1 as the fallback -- the tailwind check, not this penalty, forces the switch. Over-Ocean isn't forbidden outside its window, so it's left unlisted in the daytime band at the default penalty, same convention LSZH/EGCC use. See research doc.
